world_rationale: Independently reviewed every recipe, all 75 concept presentations, eight starters, four automatic supply tiers and nine optional goals. The finite kitchen world offers 39 crafted results, coherent reusable intermediates and meaningful alternatives. All supplies have uses; thresholds count crafts rather than gifts. Four reviewed world-local descriptions correct inherited meat/durum/autumn overstatements while preserving source snapshots. Some pastry pairs suggest several legitimate dishes: acceptance means a plausible stable game association, never unique culinary causation. Terminal dishes belong in the retained collection, while useful ingredients remain active. No adult/A5 framing or new KG claims. The historical E1 seed-count and E4 scored-target rules do not apply unchanged to this explicitly authorized unscored world. No human playtesting is claimed.

This is a finite food-themed world, not an unlimited general knowledge sandbox.
